BiblicalUsage: Shethar is one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who see the king's face and sit first in the kingdom. He is named when Vashti is deposed and the king asks what the law says.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a prince who sees the king's face is a man close to power, and Shethar's single verse puts him at the table where the queen is judged.
RelatedPeople: Shethar, Prince of Persia; Queen Esther
